_meta.description: Heart event #6 for npc_kiery: On Her Own Terms

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Kiery's shop, warm lamplight. She's just given Jack the garment]

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: I need to explain why I made this.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: If we're going to be what I think we are... you need to understand.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: I came here running. From someone who said they loved me.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: But what they loved was controlling me.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: I rebuilt myself here. Thread by thread.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: So I need you to understand — if this happens, it's because I CHOOSE it.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: Not because I need saving. Not because I'm lonely.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: Because I looked at every option and I chose you.

options.text: I would never try to control you.
I choose you too. On your terms.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: I know. That's why I'm choosing.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: You're the first person who never asked me to be anything other than what I am.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: So. Here I am. Choosing. Being terrified. But choosing anyway.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: Stay for tea? The kind I only share with people I...

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: ...with people I love. There. I said it.
